statements.subject: task
statements.description: Outputs: Task: A task object representing the processing of the message, OR Message: A direct response message (for simple interactions that don't require task tracking)
statements.guard_semantics: exactly one of allowed_values must be present; becomes NuXMV INVAR not a per-transition guard

statements.subject: streaming
statements.description: Initial response: Task object OR Message object
statements.guard_semantics: exactly one of allowed_values must be present; becomes NuXMV INVAR not a per-transition guard

statements.subject: task
statements.description: When includeArtifacts is false (the default), the artifacts field MUST be omitted entirely from each Task object in the response. The field should not be present as an empty array or null value. When includeArtifacts is true, the artifacts field should be included with its actual content (which may be an empty array if the task has no artifacts).

statements.subject: streaming
statements.description: Message-only stream: If the agent returns a Message, the stream MUST contain exactly one Message object and then close immediately. No task tracking or updates are provided.
actions: stream contains exactly one Message object
stream closes immediately after Message delivery

statements.subject: streaming
statements.description: Task lifecycle stream: If the agent returns a Task, the stream MUST begin with the Task object, followed by zero or more TaskStatusUpdateEvent or TaskArtifactUpdateEvent objects. The stream MUST close when the task reaches a terminal state (e.g. completed, failed, canceled, rejected).
actions: zero or more TaskStatusUpdateEvent or TaskArtifactUpdateEvent objects emitted
stream closes upon task reaching terminal state

statements.subject: streaming
statements.description: The operation MUST return a Task object as the first event in the stream, representing the current state of the task at the time of subscription. This prevents a potential loss of information between a call to GetTask and calling SubscribeToTask.
actions: Task object with current state emitted as first stream event

statements.subject: streaming
statements.description: The stream MUST terminate when the task reaches a terminal state (completed, failed, canceled, or rejected). The operation enables real-time monitoring of task progress and can be used with any task that is not in a terminal state.
actions: stream terminates upon task reaching terminal state

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Requests the cancellation of an ongoing task. The server will attempt to cancel the task, but success is not guaranteed (e.g., the task might have already completed or failed, or cancellation might not be supported at its current stage). The operation attempts to cancel the specified task and returns its updated state.
actions: updated task state returned to client

statements.subject: push_notification
statements.description: The operation MUST permanently remove the specified push notification configuration. No further notifications will be sent to the configured webhook after deletion. This operation MUST be idempotent - multiple deletions of the same config have the same effect.
actions: no further HTTP POST notifications sent to configured webhook URL

statements.subject: push_notification
statements.description: The operation MUST establish a webhook endpoint for task update notifications. When task updates occur, the agent will send HTTP POST requests to the configured webhook URL with StreamResponse payloads. The configuration MUST persist until task completion or explicit deletion.
actions: webhook endpoint established for task update notifications
configuration persists until task completion or explicit deletion

statements.subject: task
statements.description: The agent MAY create a new Task to process the provided message asynchronously or MAY return a direct Message response for simple interactions. The operation MUST return immediately with either task information or response message. Task processing MAY continue asynchronously after the response when a Task is returned.
actions: new Task created for asynchronous message processing OR direct Message returned
operation returns immediately with task info or response message
task processing may continue asynchronously after response
